# Chapter Structure – Working Draft

The draft specifies six chapters, or six major sections. The following distribution is an editorial working version rather than a final scene list.

| Chapter | Focus | Central Change |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | Hero's Chamber and first level | The hero accepts the mission, the Talisman, and the basic combat system. The first landscape returns. |
| 2 | Lands and nature | Several regions become accessible; reconstruction becomes the primary gameplay loop. |
| 3 | Souls, inhabitants, and cities | The world gains society, relationships, tasks, and visible civilization. |
| 4 | Memories, history, and abilities | Character progression and knowledge of the world become connected; the first major contradictions appear. |
| 5 | Truth and return journey | The Constructed World is exposed; the hero gathers Soul Energy in the liberated levels. |
| 6 | Escape, three World Passages, Jator, and Semm | A combat-focused endgame and the conclusion of the base game. |

## Still to Be Developed

- Number of levels per chapter.
- Principal characters and emotional conflicts for each region.
- Timing of individual memory revelations.
- Boss or guardian for each section.
- Transition from Chapter 4 to the full truth in Chapter 5.
- Scope of revisiting earlier areas so that the endgame does not become mere repetition.
